title: Reconsider committing UI pixel snapshots as test data

labels.name: source:agent
labels.description: Opened by an AI agent (not a human reporter)

labels.name: needs-research
labels.description: Large idea with open questions: research and file sub-issues before any code

body:
Raised by the maintainer (2026-11-09): "We should reconsider the committing of snapshots as test data".

## Why
The shell pixel snapshots (`crates/ui/tests/snapshots/egui_app.png`, `egui_app_light.png`, `egui_tool_editor.png`) cost more than they catch:
- **Every UI PR conflicts on them.** Today #296, #349, #466 and #467 all needed a merge plus a regenerate just for these binaries. Git can't merge a PNG.
- **A version bump turned main red** (#448/#449). The toolbar label is now pinned for tests, but any other incidental pixel change does the same.
- **Platform anti-aliasing differs** (#255). Goldens made on Windows fail on macOS for an unchanged tree, so contributors on other OSes can't keep them green.
- **They catch little.** A failure is "23 pixels differ"; the test doesn't say what broke.

## Options (to research and decide)
1. **Structural UI tests in the PR flow, pixel snapshots only at the cut.** This is what #359 proposes: the ignored pixel tests run in the release tier on the reference OS, and the structural tests (widget present, order, labels, via the egui test harness) run per PR. The PNGs stay committed but are refreshed once per cut, not per PR.
2. **Stop committing the PNGs.** Generate a baseline on a reference machine (or as a CI artifact on a manual workflow) and compare locally. No binaries in git, but the baseline has to be fetched.
3. **Keep the PNGs, never merge them.** `.gitattributes`: `crates/ui/tests/snapshots/*.png binary merge=ours`, plus a rule that a branch regenerates its snapshots after `git merge origin/main`. Conflicts disappear, and the regenerate step stays manual.
4. **Git LFS for snapshots.** Smaller clones, but conflicts are no better, and it adds an LFS dependency for contributors.

Recommendation to evaluate: **1 + 3**. Merge #359 (structural tests per PR, pixel lane at the cut) and add the `merge=ours` attribute meanwhile, so snapshot PNGs never block a merge.

## Done means
The open questions are answered here, a decision is recorded, and sub-issues are filed (e.g. "merge #359", "add .gitattributes for snapshots", "update AGENTS.md Testing / gate tiers"). Then this umbrella closes, per the needs-research law.

Related: #359, #255, #448, #449.
